summary: A counting delegate returned an allowed:false response with a cycle marker. Two identical cache-resolver calls produced two identical responses but only one delegate invocation, proving that the cycle-marked answer was inserted and replayed. The acyclic control in the same probe was not yet run; the result establishes the insertion behavior, not an end-to-end authorization change.
next_hint: Construct an end-to-end cyclic fixture where a cycle-marked subanswer is cached during one traversal and the same tuple is later queried as a root, then compare a cache-enabled server with a cache-disabled server.
